purpose: Read-only Canvas grade scan and teacher alert. This workflow MUST NOT modify grades, assignments, submissions, or student records. Parent communication is never sent automatically; only copy-ready templates are produced for the teacher.

scheduling.note: Local launchd LaunchAgent runs Mon-Fri 04:15 PM. launchd uses the Mac's local wall clock; this Mac is on America/New_York.

history.note: Assignment groups are manual-only; classify by verified test title keywords.

science.note: Assignment groups are manual-only; classify by verified test title keywords.

classification.note: Title keywords are applied only when the assignment group is not a canonical assessment or non-assessment group. Ambiguous classifications are reported as unresolved and never guessed.

missing.note: A submission is treated as missing when Canvas reports missing=true or the grade string matches a marker (case-insensitive).
